author: Fabian Miczek, Friedrich K. Röpke and Philipp V. F. Edelmann
title: New numerical solver for flows at various Mach numbers
review_level: selected-author-version-full-text: Section8 Eq56; Section4 explicit-RK3 discussion; AppendixA variable transforms

review.ja: 著者版の前処理行列・散逸項とRK3への言及を確認。今回は等エントロピー渦の短い時間区間に適用し、原著のGresho実験や暗黙積分を再現したとは扱いません。
review.en: Selected author-version equations and RK3 discussion were checked. This short isentropic-vortex application does not reproduce the paper’s Gresho or implicit-integration experiments.

author: Wasilij Barsukow, Philipp V. F. Edelmann, Christian Klingenberg, Fabian Miczek and Friedrich K. Röpke
title: A Numerical Scheme for the Compressible Low-Mach Number Regime of Ideal Fluid Dynamics
review_level: selected-full-text: Section3 Eqs21,31,32; Section5 Eq83 and Fourier-mode stability discussion

review.ja: 前処理散逸P⁻¹|PA|、原始変数行列と前進Eulerの厳しい刻み制限を確認。SSPRK33での本固定入力のFourier診断・実段検査は別に実施し、一般の非線形安定性やSSP保証を借用しません。
review.en: Checked the modified dissipation, primitive matrix and restrictive forward-Euler stability result. The present SSPRK33 Fourier/stage checks are separate fixed-input evidence, not a general nonlinear or SSP guarantee.

author: Seth C. Spiegel, H. T. Huynh and James R. DeBonis
title: A Survey of the Isentropic Euler Vortex Problem using High-Order Methods
review_level: selected-primary-report: parameterized vortex definitions and Sections IV.B/IV.C boundary discussion

review.ja: 一般化された渦の定義と周期境界の相互作用・せん断層の説明を確認。独自のβ3・流速(1,.5)・M∞.1/.01を明示し、全平面解と有限周期箱の違いを保持します。NASA/FRソルバーや論文図の転載ではありません。
review.en: Checked the generalized vortex and finite-periodic-boundary qualifications. The selected beta3, mean velocity(1,.5) and background Mach values are explicit adaptations, not NASA/FR execution or figure reuse.

author: Sigal Gottlieb and Chi-Wang Shu
title: Total Variation Diminishing Runge-Kutta Schemes
review_level: author-bibliography and indexed author-PDF excerpts; direct PDF fetch unavailable

review.ja: 著者の書誌と著者PDFの索引抜粋で書誌・3次TVD法の位置付けを確認。PDFを直接通読したとは記録しません。係数は次の著者レビューのSSPRK(3,3)表示とも照合します。
review.en: Bibliography and indexed author-PDF excerpts were checked. No direct full-PDF reading is claimed; coefficients are also cross-checked against the author review below.

author: Sigal Gottlieb, Chi-Wang Shu and Eitan Tadmor
title: Strong Stability-Preserving High-Order Time Discretization Methods
review_level: selected-full-author-PDF: Section4 Proposition4.1 Eq4.2 printedp100/PDFpage12; Section2.2 Lemma2.1 printedp92/PDFpage4

review.ja: 3段3次の更新係数と、前進Eulerの強安定性を前提にするSSPの条件を確認。今回のMiczek流束についてSSP・TVD・非線形安定性を一般保証せず、指定したFourier行列と実際の段状態を別途確認します。
review.en: Checked the three-stage updates and the forward-Euler hypothesis behind SSP. No general SSP/TVD/nonlinear stability guarantee is borrowed for this Miczek flux; the stated Fourier matrices and actual stage states are checked separately.
